Lina: Quick heads-up 

SolarWave (edge fleet routing) closed a 12-month Dedicated deal via TideWorks marketplace co-sell. Pilot -> production today. Big cross-functional win. :tada:

Noah: ACV $290k, start of billing next month. Pilot numbers look solidwho will own the case study + partner marketplace tile?

Priya: Marketing will own the assets. @Lina can you share the pilot metrics and a customer-approved quote? We should ask for a 20-30s CTO clip and logo permission.

Lina: Contact is Marco Ibarra, CTO  marco@solarwave.ai. Customer quote they approved: "Redwood Dedicated + TideWorks marketplace integration let us push low-latency models to the edge fleet while keeping costs predictable." Edit as needed.

Samir: Engineering notes: deployed on dedicated-us-edge with model-sharding + quantization-aware pruning, enabled token-packing and prefix KV caching. Sustained 180 QPS across 6 shards, p95 ~55ms for 320 tokens in peak bursts. Cost per inference down ~41% vs their self-hosted baseline. Perf graphs uploaded to the partner drive. Note: SolarWave applied an extra post-tokenizer compression step that reduced token counts by ~9% will add reproducibility note.

Ava (Legal): Need signed logo + testimonial release before publishing. TideWorks requests a short co-marketing addendum to our Partner MSA; I'll draft and loop them in.

Priya: Proposed timeline: draft case study + marketplace blurb by Fri, legal review Mon, customer review early next week, publish with TideWorks tile two weeks after sign-off. Also: want to highlight "edge-ready" tag on the marketplace tile.

Noah: Sales to confirm PO and billing cadence. Lina, please confirm whether they took any autoscaling credits in the pilot (affects brochure statements).

Lina: They used two burst credits during the pilot but did not purchase in the contract. We'll note that in the case study.

marketplace-bot: Marketplace tile "tideworks-solarwave" draft uploaded at 2026-04-02T10:14:22Z  awaiting partner approval.

Priya: Great work everyone. We'll hold the company-wide shout until Legal and TideWorks approve the copy. Will create invites for the kickoffs. :rocket:
